title: Unnatural death allegations: Family to protest with woman’s body outside bank in Kozhikode

ai.summary: Relatives of a 42-year-old homemaker allege bank refusal to grant a five-day grace period for loan repayment led to her death, planning to protest with her body outside the bank branch on November 16, 2026.

facts.claim: Relatives of a 42-year-old homemaker who was found dead at her house following bank attachment proceedings at Koothali near Perambra
facts.quote: Relatives and family members of a 42-year-old homemaker who was found dead at her house following bank attachment proceedings at Koothali near Perambra have announced their plans to stage a protest with her body in front of the bank branch on Monday (November 16, 2026), alleging that the officials’ refusal to grant a five-day grace period for loan repayment led to her death.

facts.claim: The deceased, identified as Kavitha Babu, was an employee at a paint shop in Kainatty, Vadakara
facts.quote: The deceased, identified as Kavitha Babu, was an employee at a paint shop in Kainatty, Vadakara.

facts.claim: The body would be taken to the Naduvannur branch of the accused bank on Monday (November 16, 2026) before funeral rites
facts.quote: The body, which is currently kept at the mortuary of the Kozhikode Medical College Hospital following post-mortem procedures, would be taken to the Naduvannur branch of the accused bank on Monday (November 16, 2026) before funeral rites are held.

facts.claim: The incident occurred around 11 a.m. on November 13 when a team comprising bank officials, an advocate commissioner, and police personnel arrived at Kavitha’s residence to execute Court-mandated attachment proceedings
facts.quote: The incident occurred around 11 a.m. on November 13 when a team comprising bank officials, an advocate commissioner, and police personnel arrived at Kavitha’s residence to execute Court-mandated attachment proceedings.

facts.claim: Following defaults in repayment, the outstanding dues, including accumulated interest, had reportedly mounted to nearly ₹50 lakh
facts.quote: Following defaults in repayment, the outstanding dues, including accumulated interest, had reportedly mounted to nearly ₹50 lakh.

facts.claim: Finding the newly constructed main residence locked upon arrival, the team initiated a search of the premises and discovered Kavitha hanging inside an old ancestral house located behind the property
facts.quote: Finding the newly constructed main residence locked upon arrival, the team initiated a search of the premises and discovered Kavitha hanging inside an old ancestral house located behind the property.

facts.claim: Though she was immediately shifted to the Perambra taluk hospital, doctors declared her dead
facts.quote: Though she was immediately shifted to the Perambra taluk hospital, doctors declared her dead.

facts.claim: Kavitha’s husband and relatives alleged that the family had earnestly requested a five-day extension to remit a stipulated portion of the dues and avoid immediate attachment, but bank authorities refused to relent
facts.quote: Kavitha’s husband and relatives alleged that the family had earnestly requested a five-day extension to remit a stipulated portion of the dues and avoid immediate attachment, but bank authorities refused to relent.

facts.claim: Holding the bank’s unyielding stance directly responsible for the tragedy, relatives and local residents said they would intensify their agitation outside the branch on Monday (November 16, 2026)
facts.quote: Holding the bank’s unyielding stance directly responsible for the tragedy, relatives and local residents said they would intensify their agitation outside the branch on Monday (November 16, 2026).

facts.claim: Meanwhile, local police have registered a case of unnatural death and launched a formal investigation into the incident
facts.quote: Meanwhile, local police have registered a case of unnatural death and launched a formal investigation into the incident.

facts.claim: Officials associated with the bank said they initiated only the legal proceedings and the allegations against them were baseless
facts.quote: Officials associated with the bank said they initiated only the legal proceedings and the allegations against them were baseless.

ai.background_note: Relatives of a 42-year-old homemaker who died after bank attachment proceedings allege the bank's refusal to grant a five-day grace period for loan repayment led to her death, planning to protest with her body outside the bank branch on November 16, 2026.
